lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 지역 통계 자료를 찾고 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm looking for local statistical data.
lines.beaver_roman: Annyeonghaseyo. Jiyeok tonggye jaryoreul chatgo itseumnida.
lines.learner: 네, 저는 마포구청 자료실 직원 김민지입니다.
lines.en: Yes, I'm Kim Minji, staff at the Mapo District Office archive.
lines.roman: Ne, jeoneun mapogucheong jaryosil jigwon gimminjiimnida.

lines.beaver_en: Where can I get local data?
lines.learner: 통계청 누리집이나 구청 자료실에서 구하실 수 있습니다.
lines.en: You can get it from the Statistics Korea website or the district office archive.
lines.roman: Tonggyecheong nurijibina gucheong jaryosireseo guhasil su itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Do many people actually use it?
lines.learner: 아니요, 작년 이용자는 삼백 명에 그쳤습니다.
lines.en: No, last year's users numbered only 300.
lines.roman: Aniyo, jangnyeon iyongjaneun sambaek myeonge geuchyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: That's fewer than I thought. Why is that?
lines.learner: 시립 도서관보다 덜 알려져 있기 때문입니다.
lines.en: It's because it's less known than the city library.
lines.roman: Sirip doseogwanboda deol allyeojeo itgi ttaemunimnida.

lines.en: Not enough. The data status differs by government office.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of work does the district office do?
lines.en: The district office is a self-governing body and manages public facilities.
A higher agency decides whether to release it.

lines.beaver: 그럼 다른 관공서 자료도 함께 볼 수 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Then can I also see data from other government offices?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom dareun gwangongseo jaryodo hamkke bol su itseumnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 관공서 자료는 신청하시면 보실 수 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, you can see government office data if you apply.
lines.roman: Ne, gwangongseo jaryoneun sincheonghasimyeon bosil su itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is low usage due to a lack of publicity?
lines.learner: 네, 홍보는 안내문 몇 장에 그쳤습니다.
lines.en: Yes, publicity was limited to just a few flyers.
lines.roman: Ne, hongboneun annaemun myeot jange geuchyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver: 자세한 설명 감사합니다. 신청서는 어디 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the detailed explanation. Where is the application form?
lines.beaver_roman: Jasehan seolmyeong gamsahamnida. Sincheongseoneun eodi itseumnikka?
lines.en: Here it is. Please fill it out and give it to me.
